user.title: Add a frame
user.description: Choose the kind of display to add. Meural uses the local LAN postcard API. Samsung EM32DX uses local MDC (experimental). Roku casts to an existing Roku media player.

add_fraimic.title: Set up Fraimic Frame
add_fraimic.description: No Fraimic frames were found automatically. Make sure your frame is awake (tap it first), then enter its IP address below — or leave blank to scan again.

data_description.host: Your frame's local IP address (leave blank to re-scan)

add_meural.title: Add Meural Canvas (local)
add_meural.description: Point at your Meural's local IP. Images are sent as JPEG postcards over your LAN — no Meural account required. Meurals are also auto-discovered on the LAN every ~20 minutes when awake.

data_description.host: Meural local IP on your network
data_description.name: Friendly name for walls and scenes

discovery_confirm_meural.title: Meural Canvas discovered
discovery_confirm_meural.description: A Meural was found at {host} via the local identify API (no cloud). Confirm the name and panel size to add it.

data_description.name: Friendly name for walls and scenes

add_samsung.title: Add Samsung EM32DX (experimental)
add_samsung.description: Local MDC push (protocol from Joyous / fayep). Pair once with the Samsung E-Paper app for Wi‑Fi, then enter IP and MDC PIN. Untested without hardware — enable Network Standby and set Wi‑Fi MAC for wake-on-send.

data_description.name: Friendly name for walls and scenes
data_description.mdc_pin: PIN from Samsung E-Paper pairing (often 6 digits)
data_description.mac_address: Wi‑Fi MAC for Wake-on-LAN (from the E-Paper app)

add_roku.title: Add Roku TV
add_roku.description: Casts images to an existing Roku via Home Assistant's own `roku` integration (media_player.play_media) — no push protocol, no cloud. Set up that Roku in HA first if it's not listed below.

data_description.roku_media_player_entity_id: An existing media_player entity from HA core's Roku integration
data_description.name: Friendly name for walls and scenes

pick_device.title: Choose a Fraimic Frame
pick_device.description: Select a frame discovered on your network.

data_description.device: Select the frame you want to add

manual.title: Add Frame by IP Address
manual.description: For frames the network scan can't see (another subnet or VLAN). Make sure the frame is awake first (tap it).

name_device.title: Name Your Frame
name_device.description: Give a friendly name to the frame at {host}.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this frame
data_description.resolution: The physical print size of your frame

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect — make sure the frame is awake and on the same network
error.no_devices_found: No Fraimic frames found on your network — try entering the IP address manually

abort.not_fraimic_device: This device is not a Fraimic frame
abort.no_roku_media_players: No available Roku media players found. Set up HA core's Roku integration first (Settings → Devices & Services → Add Integration → Roku), or every discovered Roku is already added here.

data.fast_poll_when_queued: Fast-poll frame while image is queued (every 30s)

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the frame while it is online. Does not wake a sleeping battery frame.
data_description.fast_poll_when_queued: Off by default. When on, HA probes the frame every 30 seconds while a send is waiting — useful only if you have no network device tracker (UniFi, Omada, router presence, etc.). Prefer leaving this off when presence tracking can signal wake.
data_description.frame_always_on: When on, the frame stays on Wi‑Fi and never deep-sleeps (high battery use — best when powered).
data_description.frame_sleep_minutes: Sleep time between check-ins for a new image.
data_description.resolution: Panel profile used for packing images (size / origin). Only shown when the type was never set — it does not change in normal use.
data_description.rotation_edge: Only matters when the frame's Orientation is locked to its non-native orientation (e.g. a portrait frame hung landscape). Official Fraimic frames hang left-edge-up; if images on a rotated clone come out upside down, switch this.
data_description.color_pipeline: Fast (default) uses Floyd-Steinberg dithering — near-instant. Vivid matches Fraimic's own reference converter (enhance chain + Atkinson dither against idealized primaries) for a punchier look, but takes noticeably longer per image (roughly 1-3+ seconds on typical hardware, more on weaker boxes) — worth testing before enabling on a library with many photos.
data_description.meural_email: Shared Netgear account for all Meural frames. Required for permanent pin (send) and album push. Leave blank to keep the current link.
data_description.meural_password: Required when linking or re-linking. Not stored in this form's options — only used to obtain tokens.
data_description.meural_unlink_cloud: Remove the shared Meural cloud link. Sends fall back to postcard-only until you link again.

error.meural_cloud_auth: Could not sign in to Meural / Netgear. Check email and password (2FA is not supported).
error.meural_cloud_incomplete: Enter both email and password to link a Meural account.
